decisions.reason: Datil changes the Lit production network used for access gating, but the PDF.js engine and reader entry points remain unchanged.
The Lit network selection does not change IPFS storage through Pinata or the requirement that the ebook remain removable.
Verifying current Base ERC-721 ownership through Lit is consistent with existing transfer semantics and does not change which book access, referral identity, badges, or tickets follow the NFT.
The Lit production-network configuration does not alter Brevo delivery, transactional email contents, or notification behavior.
Selecting Datil for Lit access gating does not require any change to the current About-page copy or prize-mechanics content.
The source establishes an internal Lit network configuration but does not require a change to the approved FAQ topics or copy.
The access-gating network has no effect on the amount, trigger, or recipient selection for no-referral commissions.
Datil configuration does not affect the landing-page cover's presence, placement, dimensions, or cropping.
The Lit production-network decision does not change landing-page copy, layout, terminology, or responsive behavior.
The Lit gating network is independent of the deferred Transak fiat-mint provider, payment methods, wallet provisioning, and mint destination.
Datil is the Lit Protocol network used to verify ownership; the underlying NFT remains on Base, so the Base deployment requirement is unchanged.
Automatic Lit ownership checking when opening the reader does not modify email-link authentication or dashboard access for fiat and non-crypto users.
